paths.name: wagmi/connectors
paths.message: The connectors barrel bundles every wallet SDK. Import `injected` from @wagmi/core. Adding a connector changes which advisories are reachable: update web/DEPENDENCY_ADVISORIES.md first.

patterns.message: Wallet SDKs are installed by wagmi but never bundled; that is why their advisories are unreachable. Adding one changes that: update web/DEPENDENCY_ADVISORIES.md first.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Lazy-loading a wallet SDK still bundles it (as a lazy chunk), so its advisories become reachable. Update web/DEPENDENCY_ADVISORIES.md first.
Requiring a wallet SDK bundles it, so its advisories become reachable. Update web/DEPENDENCY_ADVISORIES.md first.
